decisions.reason: This apron connectivity module builds on established offerings and, absent evidence of underperformance relative to aspirations, slack supports keeping it.
Although peripheral, it complements the software portfolio and, with no shortfall triggering problemistic search, slack justifies carrying it.
Its close alignment with existing apron equipment monitoring and the firm's investment posture make dropping unlikely without a performance shortfall.
Close to the established offer and consistent with the digital integration direction, slack allows carrying its still uncertain results.
As a safety-related service built on existing capabilities and with the firm expanding, it is kept to preserve a strategically relevant offering.
